title: Nourishing Aerated Italian Chicken Breast Skillet
description: A keto-friendly Italian dish featuring chicken breast, cooked in a clay pot with indulgent and briny flavors, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a clay pot over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides.
Add the garlic, anchovy fillets, capers, and cherry tomatoes to the pot.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and sprinkle the grana padano cheese over the top.
Return the pot to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and squeeze the lemon juice over the top.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
